snippet.title: Little Frog Game - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Little Frog Game is... a little game, about a little frog!

Little Frog Game was solo developed by myself, with the help of some great tutorials, and the support of my family and friends.

Look out for the game on my itch page, as well as the official soundtrack on my Bandcamp, when the game goes live on May 5th, 2022!

itch: https://jamphibious.itch.io/
Bandcamp: https://jamphibious.bandcamp.com/

Check out my official website for a full portfolio, or follow me on Twitter to keep up with me:
Website: https://jamphibious.com/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/JamphibiousFM

Keep hopping along.
